notes: Aggressive remote pressure with Window of Opportunity, Bravado and Jailbreak won quickly; going to 0 credits on turn 1 and a couple of slow credit turns are minor oddities.
Scored safely, but against a completely passive Runner it took 15 turns, with idle credit turns and ice spread over empty remotes instead of a fast scoring tempo.

After a good early R&D dig, the Runner clicked for credits every turn from turn 5 on, reaching 56 credits with a full grip and never installing or running while the Corp scored out of a single remote.
Used Ansel and Drafter well to lock the Runner out and scored behind them with Seamless Launch; the economy hovered at 0 for several turns but held.
Steady R&D and HQ multi-access pressure with Docklands Pass and Debbie won the game; some empty Archives runs and a Maintenance Access that ended in a jack-out wasted clicks.

Installed agendas behind unrezzable or single ice while broke (two stolen from Server 2, one from Server 4, and Méliès left at 2 advancements), and Drafter/Ansel installs repeatedly trashed its own campaigns.
Fast, focused win with Into the Depths on the remote and repeated R&D and HQ runs; the Living Mural play into F2P was a small misstep.
Clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 72 credits and never installed anything; let the Corp score from remotes unchallenged, stealing only when Hammer let the Runner through.
Mitosis left a 2-advanced Lotus Haze naked to be stolen, HQ ice stayed unrezzed while agendas sat there, two Neurospikes were played for no effect, and the economy stayed stuck at 2-6 credits.
Spotted that the Runner had an empty grip and scored Hybrid Release so the identity's net damage flatlined them; leaving R&D unprotected on turn 1 made the Finality dig easy.

Lost an early agenda behind a lone Paywall and played Oppo Research without follow-up, but then scored steadily from Ping-protected remotes; Next Big Thing sat in a remote for about 10 turns before being advanced.
Recovered from losing Buzzsaw on an early facecheck, built Trickster Taka and Boi-tatá, then hammered HQ for three steals to win on turn 8.
Rich at 10-14 credits but sat on a flooded HQ behind one weak ice, drawing into end-of-turn discards and never building a remote, and the Runner took 8 points in 4 turns.

Let early remote agendas score uncontested, then twice took heavy net damage getting past the remote ice and jacked out before accessing; sat on 28 credits clicking and drawing without breakers while the Corp scored out.
On turn 1, used the optional Carpe Diem run to facecheck unrezzed HQ ice with only 3 cards in grip against an 8-credit Corp, and was flatlined by Saisentan; risky but not obviously wrong.

Kept agendas in a full HQ behind a single Tithe while the Runner ran HQ with Docklands Pass every turn and stole five agendas there; it never added HQ ice despite 13-18 credits, and Ansel trashed its own Otto Campaign.
Strong start to 5 points with Banner on HQ, but after losing Banner it spent about 12 turns on empty Archives runs and removing Trickster Taka tags before redrawing Banner to win.
Clicked for credits on turns 2-3 while holding agendas in HQ behind one cheap ice, with an iced remote available, and lost three agendas from HQ; it also drew into discards.
Ansel-protected remotes and layered HQ and R&D ice kept the Runner out while agendas scored; credits ran near zero at times, and Ansel installed campaigns into naked servers.
Hoarded 62 credits by clicking for credits with a full grip for about 12 turns, never contesting the remote or the lightly iced R&D until the final turn, by which time the Corp was about to win.
